mapper.sql: p.id AS id, p.user_id AS userId, p.pet_id AS petId, u.nickname AS authorName, CASE WHEN pt.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pt.name || ' (' || COALESCE(pt.breed, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pt.age, '') || ')' END AS petInfo, p.title AS title, p.diagnosis_record_id AS diagnosisRecordId, AS attachedReport, p.content AS content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS commentsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likesCount, p.created_at AS createdAt
CASE WHEN dr.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(dr.affected_area, '진단') || ' · ' || COALESCE(dr.risk_label, '결과 없음') || ' (' || TO_CHAR(dr.created_at, 'YYYY.MM.DD') || ')' END
FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN pets pt ON pt.id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN diagnosis_records dr ON dr.id = p.diagnosis_record_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, pet_id, diagnosis_record_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{diagnosisRecordId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{post.title}, content = #{post.content}, diagnosis_record_id = #{post.diagnosisRecordId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT dr.id AS id, dr.affected_area AS affectedArea, dr.risk_label AS riskLabel, dr.risk_level AS riskLevel, COALESCE(dr.affected_area, '진단') || ' · ' || COALESCE(dr.risk_label, '결과 없음') || ' (' || TO_CHAR(dr.created_at, 'YYYY.MM.DD') || ')' AS label, dr.created_at AS createdAt FROM diagnosis_records dr JOIN pets p ON p.id = dr.pet_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND dr.user_id = u.id ORDER BY dr.id DESC
